origine_fr: L'ancien 傳 réunit l'homme 亻 et 專, qui donne le son : les relais de poste. 传 écrit 专, lu zhuān, qui ne donne plus le son de chuán. D'un relais à l'autre, on transmet, on répand.
origine_en: The old form 傳 joins a person 亻 and 專, which gives the sound: post relays. 传 writes 专, read zhuān, which no longer gives the sound chuán. From one relay to the next, things are passed on and spread.

phrase.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhàopiàn chuán gěi le wǒ.
